description:
Large 1, 2 and 3 Bed apartments available to rent in Clontarf. 
Make yourself at home in this unique setting.

Set in the established and picturesque neighbourhood of Clontarf, Occu Verville is a collection of excellently finished apartments, sitting within the grounds of our stunning refurbished and redeveloped Victorian house and gate lodge. Enjoy spacious apartments, full of character with bespoke, crafted interiors and beautifully landscaped surrounds. Set across a mix of beautifully refurbished period buildings, and stylish new builds, Occu Verville is a unique and stunning development.
 
Nestled in a superb location between Clontarf and Killester, there is a great selection of trendy bars, restaurants, shops, as well as plenty of other activities and amenities close by for you to explore! 

Speaking of exploring, the Dart station at Killester is just a few minutes walk away which makes your morning commute easy peasy, and on days off, allows you to check out the whole Dublin coastline, from Malahide to Greystones. Enjoy bright open-plan living spaces, excellent finishes and considered design that will help you feel at home right away. 

Standard features of Occu Brookwood apartments include: 
- Bespoke, designer furniture packages 
- A-Rated appliances 
- Plenty of storage space 
- Heating and hot water is provided is provided by the latest Dimplex air source heat pump and electric radiator systems, meaning there is just one energy bill! 

At Occu, we believe that renting should be better. That's why we're working hard to bring you the best: smarter, benefit focused and centred around the needs of our residents. No uncertainty, no hidden costs, stunning homes (and we'll let your pets move in too!). 
Better Renting. That's different. 

Please note: BER's range from A2-A3 
Please note, photos may not be specific to each available apartment, but all apartments are finished to similar standard.
